_om: Engelsk översättning av ormen.json. Bara texter; siffrorna står i den svenska filen. Korten kopplas ihop med sina id:n.

texter: You reach into the hoard and take {antal} gold. The serpent sleeps on.
The coins are lukewarm and sticky. You take {antal} gold. Nothing stirs.
Carefully, coin by coin: {antal} gold. The breathing goes on at the same slow pace.
You take {antal} gold. A coil slides aside and the floor beneath you sways. Then all is still again.
{antal} gold. A vast breath draws through the hall, and the whole room seems to go with it. The serpent sleeps. For now.
andra: The floor sways beneath you. Something vast has moved in its sleep.
The whole tower seems to draw a deep breath.

texter: A coin slips from your hand and clinks against the others. The breathing stops. Two yellow eyes open in the dark.
You pull at a chain that is stuck fast. The whole hoard shifts, and what lies around it wakes.

vaknar_andra: A hissing fills the tower, so loud the stones tremble. The serpent is awake!
A sound like a storm through a pipe. The serpent has woken.
kastas_ut: The coils lash out and you are hurled across the hall and out through an opening. You drop {forlust} gold and take {skada} wounds.
Something strikes you in the chest and you fly out of the chamber. {forlust} gold spills from your bag. You take {skada} wounds.
somnar_om: The hissing ebbs away. The breathing slows again, but it sounds more easily woken now.
somn: The serpent sleeps deeply. The breaths are long and heavy.
The serpent sleeps uneasily. The breaths come faster.
The serpent is close to waking. You see the coils tighten.
